I am a mathematics PhD student at [Drexel University](https://drexel.edu/coas/academics/departments-centers/mathematics/).

My research interests are in combinatorics broadly, but my focus has lately been on dynamical algebraic combinatorics.

You can reach me at `peter.mao@drexel.edu`.
